tagline: A música que faz o amor voltar a tocar

theme_strategy.theme_description: Luxury Romantic Nocturne - Deep rich dark velvet canvas (#0D0914) with warm golden champagne highlights (#E6A15C), subtle rose gold glow (#D9777F), and crisp warm ivory typography (#FAF7F2). Creates an intimate, emotional, studio-crafted experience.

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: glow-border animation around primary callout cards with gold blur bleed
visual_enhancers.editorial_marquee: slow drifting ribbon with low-contrast warm text and generous horizontal gaps
visual_enhancers.audio_waveform: interactive HTML5 Canvas audio spectrum visualizer in rose-gold and amber

layout_and_grid.bento_grid_mode: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for hero, occasions, and customer reaction stories
layout_and_grid.spacing_scale: Generous spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, py-20, py-28) to give cinematic breathing room
layout_and_grid.header: Fixed sticky header with backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0D0914]/80 border-b border-amber-500/10 z-50). Visible nav items: Exemplos, Como Funciona, Avaliações, Ocasiões, FAQ, and primary CTA 'Criar a minha música'
layout_and_grid.footer: Rich dark footer with massive display brand mark ('REPRISE'), link columns, guarantee badge, trust seals, and currency selector (€ EUR)

sections: Sticky Glass Header with SVG logo mark + Nav links + CTA

4-Step 'Como Funciona' visual timeline (1. Conte a sua história, 2. Escrevemos a letra, 3. Produção em estúdio, 4. Entrega em 24h)
Interactive Samples Player with occasion tabs (Aniversário, Casamento, Dia da Mãe, Amor & Reconciliação, Memorial, etc.) + Genre toggle + Audio wave visualizer
12 Occasions Grid (12 curated high-quality image tiles with overlay text)
Verified Customer Reviews with Trustpilot badge and detailed testimonial cards
Final Kinetic CTA section with ambient vinyl graphic preview
Rich Footer with privacy policy, terms, support contact, and logo mark

steps: Step 1: Para quem é a música? (Parceiro(a), Mãe, Pai, Filho(a), Melhor Amigo(a), Avó/Avô, Outro)
Step 2: Qual é o nome da pessoa homenageada?
Step 3: Qual é a ocasião especial? (Aniversário, Casamento, Reconciliação, Agradecimento, Dia da Mãe, Homenagem)
Step 4: Escolha o estilo musical (Bossa Nova, Acoustic Pop, Fado Pop, Balada Romântica, MPB, Epic Cinematic)
Step 5: Selecione a voz (Masculina / Feminina) e o tom emocional (Emocionante/Lagrimas, Alegre/Contagiante, Nostálgico, Suave)
Step 6: Conte a sua história e memórias (Textarea com inspirações: Como se conheceram? Frases marcantes? Momentos inesquecíveis?)
Step 7: Dados para contacto e envio (Seu Nome, Seu E-mail)
Step 8: Resumo da Encomenda & Escolha do Plano (€39 Normal 48h vs €59 Express 24h + extras como Faixa Instrumental + Letra Impressa PDF) -> Simulação Checkout Stripe

features: Dedicated romantic song page with customized header
Custom audio player with play/pause, seekbar, current time, duration, volume, and downloadable MP3 link
Synchronized / Displayed lyrics with highlighted stanzas
Story recap box showing recipient name, occasion, and original memories
Share modal / link copy for WhatsApp & Social Media
Option to request revision or contact support
Orders table with filters (All, Pending, In Production, Completed)
Order detail view showing customer memories and selected style
Audio Upload modal to attach MP3 file URL or upload audio to order ID
Status update toggle (Notificar cliente por E-mail ao concluir)

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, audio controls, wizard steps, and modal buttons MUST have descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow Portuguese language for all UI copy (e.g. 'Transforme as suas memórias numa música inesquecível', 'Criar a minha música', 'Pronto em 24h').
Use EUR (€) for all pricing (€39.00 standard, €59.00 express delivery 24h).
Implement smooth scrolling with Lenis or CSS smooth behavior and line-by-line reveal animations with framer-motion.
Build custom interactive audio players with play/pause state and simulated waveform visualizations for sample listening.
Ensure all 8 steps of the creation flow /criar operate smoothly with state retention, step back/next, validation, and final order submit.
Implement full admin dashboard at /admin with simulated order status toggle, order detail view, and custom audio upload dialog.
Every key interactive element MUST have data-testid.
